AGENTS.md: Initial intent, all routing/skill selection, announcements, concise global safety and repository boundaries. Always loaded.
skills/coding-shape/SKILL.md: Default Goal, product discovery/questions, specification and independent proof delegation.
skills/coding-ship/SKILL.md: Authorized implementation, repair, verification, final review/completion.
skills/coding-fix/SKILL.md: Known defect classification, focused repair and reopened-feature obligations.
skills/coding-operate/SKILL.md: Runtime diagnosis, authorized remediation, live read-back.
docs/harness/coding/proof.md: Keep: Shape authors, Ship executes, Fix restores or repairs setup; shared acceptance contract.
docs/harness/coding/status.md: Keep: Shape registers, Ship claims/completes, reopened Fix changes status; shared CLI/schema.
docs/harness/coding/evidence.md: Keep: Ship/proof authors capture verification; Fix/Operate retain appropriate evidence; shared capture command and privacy constraints.
docs/harness/workflow.md: Remove: only AGENTS/README current callers; narrative duplicates lifecycle skills.
docs/harness/coding/rules.md: Remove: routing and announcements to AGENTS; lifecycle behavior to owner skill, references only where needed.
docs/harness/coding/research.md: Remove: bounded source verification becomes a concise general instruction; no unique mechanism.
docs/harness/safety.md: Remove: global approvals belong AGENTS; runtime details already Operate; completion already Ship/Fix.
README.md: Human orientation with direct links; no required instruction layer.
docs/features/: Historical decisions and verification, read only for feature-specific context; excluded from routine harness loading.
